notes.title: Welcome to the world of Nubla!
notes.notes:
It's been a long and windy road, but we're finally here -- Nubla is now available on Steam! This journey began years ago, when the indie studio Gammera Nest and the Museum of Modern Art Thyssen-Bornemisza started exploring for ways to incorporate technology, and more specifically games, in their educational program educaTHYSSEN. A group of game design students from the Spanish university ESNE joined the efforts, and thus began a process that has been truly enlightening for everyone involved. We've talked about it a little bit in a series of development diaries which first entry we released a couple of days ago:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zeJBXPoVGyg&feature=youtu.be

Nubla was released first as a PlayStation 4 exclusive in 2016, and after these years we're super excited to see it coming to computers on Steam. We can't wait to hear from you and receive your feedback. We hope you enjoy this wonderful journey through art as much as we did!
